issues.explanation: Here 因 is a conjunction meaning “because,” not the verb “to cause.”
The gloss is a dictionary cross-reference rather than a learner-facing explanation of this place name.
In 突然出击, 突然 functions adverbially and means “suddenly,” so “sudden” is misleading in context.
Here 因 introduces the reason and means “because,” not “cause.”
In 三人, 三 means “three”; it is not the surname “San.”
